_notes: Post-reset layout 2026-08-22 (evening). Two roster bugs that froze this file are FIXED and
green: (1) run-roster --loop no longer relaunches a rate-limited model fresh every cycle —
a deferred spec cools off per-spec and RESUMES in place, with a 10m cycle gap, so no more
3x/min hammering; (2) the session account is now harness-bound (runner/SDK) — the model no
longer sees or passes an account, so a lane can no longer land on the wrong one by omission.
Worldserver is up and healthy on the reclaim image; NO rebuild was needed for either fix.
Safe to launch once the operator confirms.
The fleet is this file. One lane = one sequential episode stream = one game account;
parallelism is exactly the number of enabled lanes. Edit while run-fleet is up: it
re-reads every 60s. enabled:false drains a lane (its roster process is SIGTERMed at
the next episode boundary — the running episode finishes); enabled:true or a new
lane spawns one. A malformed edit never kills running lanes: the fleet complains and
keeps the last good config.
Lane policy: OpenCode Zen and OpenRouter lanes carry FREE models only. One stream
per MODEL config: a model appears in at most one lane, so no single model pool is
ever hit concurrently. Several lanes may share a provider (they share that API
key's account-wide rate limits — the adapter's 429/backoff handling is what keeps
that polite; if a provider starts daily-capping, disable lanes rather than retry
harder). claude models run ONLY via the claude-subscription driver, never through
an openai-driver lane.
Entries use the exact per-entry schema of roster JSONs (model, driver, effort,
character, race, class, episodeMs, ...). account comes from the lane. A lane may
point at a rosterFile instead of inline entries. Run ids derive as
fleet-<lane>-<model-slug>[-<effort>]-<date> so fleet runs never collide with
hand-launched rosters.
sub-opus is the burn switch: flip it to true when there is subscription budget to
burn, back to false to stop after the episode in flight.

ox-alpha lane: stealth/ox-alpha is the model that PASSED the Phase 0 gate (gate2-ox-4).
It fell out of the fleet when the fleet became the launch path. Still live and free on
OpenRouter (verified 2026-08-22, pricing 0/0). Given the ~1-week stealth window it gets
its own account (RUNNER) and a solo lane for clean continuous data — do not pad it.
preflight: the per-tick gate (ADR-0023, amended 2026-08-23). Before it spawns ANY lane, and again
whenever the server identity changes (a worldserver recreate or restart), the supervisor runs
`smokes` — entries with DISTINCT accounts run in parallel, entries sharing one run in order. A
failure spawns nothing and is re-checked every tick, so a fix or a rollback unblocks the fleet
with no operator action; --status shows the last gate result. timeoutMs is the budget for the
whole gate (every child gets the same deadline), ~3x the measured critical path. Measured
2026-08-23 as PROBE: quest-accept-status 19.6s, kill-credit 41.9s.
SHIPPED SEQUENTIAL ON SMOKE (critical path 62s, timeoutMs 190000). AFTER the next worldserver
recreate has picked up SMOKE2 in AC_WRATH_BENCH_ACCOUNTS, flip kill-credit's account to SMOKE2
and timeoutMs to 130000: the two chains then run in parallel and the gate is ~42s. Not before:
a smoke bound to an account the module does not permit answers 403 account_not_permitted, the
gate fails, and NO lane spawns until it is fixed. (The running supervisor only reads this new
entry shape after its own restart; until then it keeps its last good config and complains.)
`deploySmokes` is the deploy-time FULL arc (module-quest.ts: eight kills to objective completion
and the kill quest's own turn-in, ~4 min). infra/deploy-worldserver.sh runs it once per deploy
after the fast gate; the supervisor never does. deployTimeoutMs is its own budget.
Accounts: SMOKE and SMOKE2 are load-bearing (one per parallel chain); SMOKE3/SMOKE4 exist in auth
(bootstrapped 2026-08-23) and are in compose's AC_WRATH_BENCH_ACCOUNTS for headroom, but the
module only permits them after the NEXT worldserver recreate — until then a smoke bound to
SMOKE3/4 answers 403 account_not_permitted and the gate blocks every lane. Never PROBE: that is
the ad-hoc debugging account and the gate would fight whoever is using it.
2026-08-23 (later): module-navigation.ts (arrived+meshZ, target_off_mesh, too_far, clean status
vocabulary) is now preflight-gate ready — MODULE_ACCOUNT, character-delete-first, Smokenav — and
added to `smokes` on SMOKE3. SMOKE3 is a DISTINCT account from SMOKE/SMOKE2, so this is its own
parallel chain and does NOT touch timeoutMs (the SMOKE chain, quest-accept-status + kill-credit
sequential at ~62s, still owns the critical path; nav's own chain projects at ~15s). Per the note
above, SMOKE3 is not yet in the module's allowlist on the RUNNING worldserver — until the next
recreate this entry answers 403 account_not_permitted and blocks every lane. The orchestrator is
doing that recreate within the hour; this entry takes effect after it lands and the supervisor is
restarted to pick up the edit. No smoke was run to measure this live — a drain window is imminent.
Local lanes: an openai lane may point apiBase at a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible
endpoint (e.g. LM Studio on the LAN). That is NOT a shared free-cloud pool, so it
is exempt from the free-model-suffix rule — but the claude bar still holds: no
claude-* id ever rides an openai lane. Its apiKeyEnv (LMSTUDIO_KEY) is a dummy the
server ignores; the pipeline just needs the var to exist in .env.

_comment: nav-probe: a long-running, UNSCORED navigation probe (ADR-0024). One 6h episode per
enable (loop:false), on the subscription driver, with an explicit travel objective — the
question is whether the navigation surface is usable unprompted, not how fast a model
levels. race 3 / class 2 is a Dwarf Paladin, the same start the sub-sonnet lane uses:
Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh, so the nearest capital really is Ironforge and the
Deeprun Tram is the interesting leg only if the model routes via Stormwind.
watchdogs: no-xp is DISABLED (travel earns no XP for hours and would trip it), idle stays
at 20m, wall clock is the 6h episode. maxToolCalls is raised from the 500 default because
the claude driver has been observed at ~4 tool calls/minute — 500 would end the run about
two hours in, as tool-call-limit, and the trajectory would read like a harness fault.
Account SHAKEOUT, shared with sub-sonnet: the one-lane-per-account check only binds
ENABLED lanes. Enabling this one while sub-sonnet is still enabled does not skip a lane —
the whole file is rejected and the supervisor keeps the last good config, so flip both in
lanes.name: nav-probe
lanes.objective: Travel from Coldridge Valley to Ironforge, then take the Deeprun Tram from Ironforge to Stormwind. Use roads and the game's own transport (the tram; flight masters once discovered). Keep a travel log in the scratchpad: destination chosen, route chosen, what worked, what failed and why. In each city, find the flight master and a trainer and note them in the log. Once in Stormwind, keep exploring and questing there.
